steps.src: const P = Object.getPrototypeOf(window.webkit.messageHandlers.lumina); if (!P.__timed) { const post = P.postMessage; window.__ops = window.__ops || {}; P.postMessage = function (m) { const t = performance.now(), op = m && m.op; const done = () => { (window.__ops[op] = window.__ops[op] || []).push(+(performance.now() - t).toFixed(2)); }; const p = post.call(this, m); return p && p.then ? p.then(v => { done(); return v; }, e => { done(); throw e; }) : (done(), p); }; P.__timed = true; } return JSON.stringify({ timed: P.postMessage !== undefined && !!P.__timed, same: window.webkit.messageHandlers.lumina === window.webkit.messageHandlers.lumina })

const R = window.__rs = { t0: performance.now(), at: {}, series: [], total: 0 }; const mark = (k, t) => { if (R.at[k] == null) R.at[k] = +(t - R.t0).toFixed(1); }; let lastS = 0; R.timer = setInterval(() => { const l = __probe.logic(), t = performance.now(); if (!l) return; const rl = l.state.realLoad, done = rl ? rl.done : (l.state.realInfo ? R.total : 0); if (rl) { mark('reading', t); R.total = rl.total; } if (l.real && l.real.length && l.state.view === 'cull') { mark('shown', t); const el = document.querySelector('[data-screen-label="1 Cull"]'); if (el && (R.at.firstThumb == null || R.at.screenFull == null)) { const vr = el.getBoundingClientRect(); let ready = 0, wait = 0; for (const im of el.querySelectorAll('img')) { const r = im.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.bottom < vr.top || r.top > vr.bottom || r.width < 8) continue; if (im.complete && im.naturalWidth > 0 && parseFloat(getComputedStyle(im).opacity) > 0.99) ready++; else wait++; } if (ready) mark('firstThumb', t); if (ready >= 6 && !wait) mark('screenFull', t); } } for (const n of [100, 500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000]) if (done >= n) mark('read' + n, t); if (R.at.reading != null && !rl && l.state.realInfo) { mark('finished', t); clearInterval(R.timer); } if (t - lastS >= 250) { lastS = t; R.series.push([+(t - R.t0).toFixed(0), done]); } }, 16); return true
